messages:
emily: Quick ask — we need a compact data-visual pack for next week's launch webinar. Three hero tiles (latency vs cost, throughput wins, routing/fallback), plus a 16:9 slide template and social variants (1200x628, 800x800). Brand-compliant, accessible colors. Can we get a first pass by Thu?
sam: On it. Do we have the final benchmark numbers or a sample dataset to build charts from?
marco: dropping a drive link with the CSV + notes: https://drive.redwood/launch/metrics.csv — highlights in the doc: p50/p95 latency, cost-per-1k tokens, throughput at target batch sizes. Also added a small sketch for the routing diagram.
sam: got the CSV, thanks. Quick Q: should the charts show raw tokens or normalized (per 1k)?
tanya: normalize per 1k tokens for consistency on social, add a callout for quantization delta. Brand rules: use Redwood Sans, logomark min 72px, maintain 4.5:1 contrast on primary text.
emily: good call. Also need alt-text snippets for CMS and short copy variants for slides (title + 2-line deck hero). Include a dark theme alternate.
sam: will produce Figma file + exports: 16:9 slide master (.fig), PNGs at required sizes, and SVGs for the micro-diagrams. ETA Thu EOD. :thumbsup:
emily: awesome. Marco — can you confirm legal copy for the hero stat language? We avoid absolute claims like "fastest" unless we have test bench.
marco: confirmed — we'll use "low-latency" and reference our test conditions in microcopy. I'll add the exact phrasing in the doc.
sam: pinging design bot to create a branch in the shared file so I can start laying out components.
figma-bot: Created file 'Launch / Data Viz Pack' and branch 'webinar-tiles-4387654322' — https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/Launch-Data-Viz-Pack?node-id=0%3A1
marco: micro-diagram ask: simple 3-node SVG showing smart routing fallback (primary: hosted, fallback: dedicated, final: private) with arrows and labels. Keep it flat/iconic.
sam: noted — SVG + PNG. Style notes: flat icons, rounded caps, 2px stroke. Tanya, confirm stroke and icon style?
tanya: yes — match brand iconography: rounded corners, stroke 2px, neutral stroke color on light theme, swap for light stroke on dark theme. Add accessible color labels and ensure no text under 12px in exports.
sam: will include a handoff checklist (export specs, alt text, copy variants). Example alt text I plan to include: "Line chart comparing cost per 1k tokens across models; lower is better."
emily: perfect. After designs are ready I'll loop in @brand-ops for sign-off and legal for the slide copy. If anyone hits blockers, flag here. :rocket:
marco: one tiny priority change — please also make a PNG-friendly thumbnail (600x360) for the webinar registration page.
sam: added to the list. Will deliver 600x360 thumbnail + 1200x628 social + 800x800 tile.
emily: thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. If design needs placeholder numbers, use the CSV and mark as "representative" in the asset metadata.
sam: noted, will annotate frames with variable tokens and include a short export naming scheme e.g., `launch_tiles_v1_web_1200x628.png`.
emily: ok closing the loop — I’ll post the brand/legal reviewers once you upload the branch. :sparkles:
